description: This is a source code file for a command-line interface (CLI) tool named 'universalinit', which automates project initialization for various project types. It includes functions for parsing CLI arguments, creating project configurations, retrieving template initialization info, and outputting JSON results. The script handles both project setup and retrieval of run commands for specific project types.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a string of comma-separated key=value pairs into a dictionary with inferred data types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from parsed CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object for retrieving template info without full user input.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path string into an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary suitable for JSON serialization, ensuring paths are absolute.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and prints a JSON object indicating success or failure, along with optional template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the JSON containing a specific project type and its run command.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the --get-run-command CLI option, retrieving and outputting the run command for a given project type.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, manages control flow for project initialization or retrieving run command, and handles exceptions.
